scope: Admitted COM6/COM7, REDMAGIC YouTube source COM7, Linux real-music standby COM6, continuous BLE; Samsung excluded
capture_design: Optional selected-identity capture,1632B per armed board plus temporary read snapshot. Retains up to96 CRC-protected metadata events beyond the rolling copy-history lifetime. Physical carrier tags join native submission/completion to receiver acceptance. No audio payload, allocation or serial output in radio callbacks. Owned captures are cleared after each episode.

single_group_test.meaning: Selected repairs passed integrity, playback handoff and decoding. Missing later replicas occurred before the instrumented receive-acceptance point, not in codec decoding. This does not identify RF versus native callback filtering.

burst_with_limit4.burst: Seven adjacent groups, all four originals suppressed; focus on last group
burst_with_limit4.failure_cases: Cases1 and3: only outcome7 (repair-reference admission limit), zero repair API submissions/completions, four missing codec frames for each selected target
burst_with_limit4.meaning: A concrete source-side capacity rejection occurred before any selected repair transmission.

burst_with_limit8.case2: Five tagged NACKs reached source callback and passed wire CRC. Only the last generated a repair decision; its one native-completed urgent repair had no matching receiver acceptance.
burst_with_limit8.case7: Receiver submitted/completed five NACKs; source accepted and CRC-validated the first two, but neither generated a repair decision or API submission. Selected group concealed four frames.
burst_with_limit8.meaning: Increasing reference capacity removed the observed capacity gate, but silently ignored requests and missing receive acceptance remain separate failures. Unequal finite cases are not a statistical stability qualification.

next_candidate.changes: Default repair-reference limit8; bind NACK admission to own group/session and cached packet rather than receiver codec hints. Explicitly record epoch rejection, transition-busy and unavailable-buffer decisions.
next_candidate.identity_invariant: Wire CRC, group/session identity and source-owned cache lookup remain mandatory. Original SBC bytes/sample counts and four originals unchanged.
next_candidate.slot_budget: At current64ms original spacing, about17 original groups plus8 repair groups fit32 scheduling slots. References pin existing payloads without allocating additional audio slabs.
next_candidate.tests: 123 protocol tests pass, including receiver codec-hint independence and balanced shared references for a seven-group burst; two delivery-parser integrity tests pass.
next_candidate.physical_result: evidence/delivery-path-1793712339070764200/receipt.json:7/8 selected burst targets recovered, one still had no repair decision despite validated NACK reception; codec-hint removal alone did not eliminate the silent path.

startup_observation: After capture-build installation, initial Classic admission failed with working controllers and accepted scan/advertising commands. Temporary COEX2 allowed subsequent Linux/REDMAGIC admission. COEX0 and receive windows1 were independently restored before the full-workload episodes; cold automatic admission remains unqualified.
limits: Controlled originals were intentionally suppressed, so these receipts prove selected repair behavior only. They do not prove continuous gap-free audio, physical synchronization, one-hour stability or100-node operation.

pacing_drop_fix.cause: Global8ms next_repair guard returned without retaining incoming requests. Such returns incremented deferred but emitted no repair decision.
pacing_drop_fix.change: Keep immutable shared repair message queued with ready_us on the pacing grid. Subtract queue delay from the copy budget; urgent requests may bypass a pacing tail. Default reference budget8 remains.
pacing_drop_fix.remaining_failure: Case7:three API-accepted and driver-completed repairs, zero receiver acceptance events, four concealed codec frames.
